segments.text: Delivered a lecture on
Modelica Model Development for Reliable Data Center Thermal Management
at Penn State.
Received the
Marlene and Joseph Borda Graduate Fellowship
for conference travel support.
Our paper
Cooling Response in Liquid-Cooled Data Centers Under Spatiotemporal IT Workload Variability
was accepted by the ASHRAE Winter Conference 2027.
Received the
Harry G. Miller Fellowship in Engineering
for presenting at the American Modelica and FMI Conference.
Received the
ASHRAE College of Fellows Travel Award
to attend the ASHRAE Annual Conference.
Successfully passed my
Ph.D. Comprehensive Exam
on demand response in liquid-cooled data centers.
Our project
Development of Digital Twin for Liquid Cooled Data Centers
was selected for the Penn State ICDS Rising Researcher Collaborations Program.
